prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

follow_ups:

Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.core.errors import AppException, ErrorCode
+from app.models import Episode, Project
+
+
+def ordered_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> list[Episode]:
+    """Serialize order changes per project and repair existing gaps or ties."""
+    project = session.exec(select(Project).where(Project.id == project_id).with_for_update()).first()
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_PROJECT)
+    episodes = session.exec(select(Episode).where(
+        Episode.project_id == project_id, Episode.deleted_at == None
+    ).order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id).execution_options(populate_existing=True)).all()
+    for number, episode in enumerate(episodes, 1):
+        if episode.episode_order != number:
+            episode.episode_order = number
+            session.add(episode)
+    session.flush()
+    return list(episodes)

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4

+def test_duplicate_episode_preserves_content_and_is_independent(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Story', 'genres': []}).json()
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        workspace = session.get(Workspace, UUID(project['workspace_id']))
+        credits = workspace.credits
+        original = Episode(project_id=UUID(project['id']), title='First', episode_order=2,
+                           story_summary='Summary', character_outfits={'Hero': 'coat'})
+        session.add(original)
+        session.flush()
+        original_id = original.id
+        session.add(Episode(project_id=original.project_id, title='Later', episode_order=7))
+        session.add(StoryCut(episode_id=original.id, cut_order=3, script='Action', selected_layout='wide',
+                             aspect_ratio='16:9', image_path='cuts/original.png',
+                             dialogues=[{'speaker': 'Hero', 'text': 'Hello'}],
+                             appearing_characters=[{'id': 'hero', 'name': 'Hero'}]))
+        session.commit()
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{original_id}/duplicate', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    data = response.json()
+    assert data['title'] == 'First (Copy)'
+    assert data['episode_order'] == 2
+    assert data['story_summary'] == 'Summary'
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        copied = session.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == UUID(data['id']))).one()
+        assert (copied.cut_order, copied.script, copied.selected_layout, copied.image_path) == (3, 'Action', 'wide', 'cuts/original.png')
+        assert copied.dialogues == [{'speaker': 'Hero', 'text': 'Hello'}]
+        assert copied.appearing_characters == [{'id': 'hero', 'name': 'Hero'}]
+        assert session.get(Workspace, UUID(project['workspace_id'])).credits == credits
+        copied.script = 'Changed'
+        session.add(copied)
+        session.commit()
+        original_cut = session.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == original_id)).one()
+        assert original_cut.script == 'Action'
+    assert client.delete(f'/api/v1/episodes/{original_id}', headers=headers).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{data['id']}", headers=headers).status_code == 200
+    assert client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{original_id}/duplicate', headers=headers).status_code == 404
+

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Episode, StoryCut, User, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def test_restore_retains_cuts_and_inserts_at_deleted_position(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=headers, json={'title': 'Story', 'genres': []}).json()
+    ids = []
+    for title in ('First', 'Middle', 'Last'):
+        response = client.post('/api/v1/episodes', headers=headers, json={
+            'project_id': project['id'], 'title': title, 'episode_order': 1,
+        })
+        ids.append(response.json()['id'])
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=UUID(ids[1]), cut_order=1, script='Action', selected_layout='wide',
+                       aspect_ratio='16:9', image_path='cut.png', dialogues=[{'text': 'Hello'}])
+        session.add(cut)
+        session.commit()
+        cut_id = cut.id
+    assert client.delete(f'/api/v1/episodes/{ids[1]}', headers=headers).status_code == 204
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{ids[1]}/restore', headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.json()['episode_order'] == 2
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/?project_id={project['id']}", headers=headers).json()
+    assert [(ep['title'], ep['episode_order']) for ep in episodes] == [('First', 1), ('Middle', 2), ('Last', 3)]
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        cut = session.get(StoryCut, cut_id)
+        assert cut.episode_id == UUID(ids[1])
+        assert (cut.script, cut.image_path, cut.dialogues) == ('Action', 'cut.png', [{'text': 'Hello'}])
+    assert client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{ids[1]}/restore', headers=headers).status_code == 404
+
+
+def test_restore_clamps_position_and_requires_workspace_membership(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    member = signup(client, email='member@example.com')
+    outsider = signup(client, email='outsider@example.com')
+    project = client.post('/api/v1/projects', headers=owner, json={'title': 'Private', 'genres': []}).json()
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        user = session.exec(select(User).where(User.email == 'member@example.com')).one()
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=UUID(project['workspace_id']), user_id=user.id))
+        session.commit()
+    ids = []
+    for title in ('First', 'Last'):
+        ids.append(client.post('/api/v1/episodes', headers=owner, json={
+            'project_id': project['id'], 'title': title, 'episode_order': 1,
+        }).json()['id'])
+    for episode_id in reversed(ids):
+        assert client.delete(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}', headers=owner).status_code == 204
+    assert client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{ids[1]}/restore', headers=outsider).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/restore', headers=owner).status_code == 404
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{ids[1]}/restore', headers=member)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json()['episode_order'] == 1
+    response = client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{ids[0]}/restore', headers=member)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json()['episode_order'] == 1
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/?project_id={project['id']}", headers=owner).json()
